scripts.dev:api: npm run cf:config && wrangler dev --config wrangler.generated.jsonc --port 8787
scripts.dev:full: npm run build && concurrently -k -n api,web -c yellow,cyan "npm:dev:api" "npm:dev"
scripts.deploy: npm run build && node scripts/with-d1.mjs -- wrangler deploy --config wrangler.generated.jsonc
scripts.deploy:dry: npm run build && npm run cf:config && wrangler deploy --config wrangler.generated.jsonc --dry-run --outdir=.wrangler/dry-run
scripts.db:migrate:local: npm run cf:config && wrangler d1 execute cashsim-db --local --config wrangler.generated.jsonc --file=./migrations/0001_init.sql && wrangler d1 execute cashsim-db --local --config wrangler.generated.jsonc --file=./migrations/0002_workspaces.sql
scripts.db:migrate:remote: node scripts/with-d1.mjs -- wrangler d1 execute cashsim-db --remote --config wrangler.generated.jsonc --file=./migrations/0001_init.sql && node scripts/with-d1.mjs -- wrangler d1 execute cashsim-db --remote --config wrangler.generated.jsonc --file=./migrations/0002_workspaces.sql
